report.headline: Ads keywords tightened for winter; conversion tracking gaps corrected

done.text: Reviewed search terms and keywords from Sept 1–Nov 13, then trimmed the winter campaign keyword list from 34 to 11 and added 6 high-intent terms (furnace repair, no heat, emergency repair, furnace tune-up). Paused keywords that spent money without producing leads.

Added a shared negative keyword list to block competitor names, troubleshooting searches and equipment-shopping queries, while keeping every keyword and search term that has previously produced a lead.
Identified and corrected missing or wrong lead sources on several conversion records — contacts are now automatically tagged and sourced in the CRM based on where the lead came from.

in_progress.text: Auditing the web lead capture flow to ensure campaign and channel source data is passed through correctly on all paid traffic landing pages, so every inbound form submission is properly attributed.
Google listing verification for the Burr Ridge location is still in progress — waiting on physical signage to be installed before the live video verification step can be completed.
Google listing posts for Quality HVAC and Fibid profiles are being resumed this week after a gap; first post on each profile is being prepared, with a weekly cadence planned going forward.

waiting_on_you.text: Burr Ridge Google listing verification: once the "Fibid Heating & Air Conditioning" signs (door, lobby directory, inside decal) are installed, please initiate the Google live video verification from your own Google login — the steps document was sent on Nov 6.

next_week.text: Complete the web lead tracking audit and confirm that UTM/source parameters are visible on every lead record for paid traffic.
Publish the first Google listing post on both the Quality HVAC and Fibid profiles and confirm the planned weekly posting day for each.

internal_flags.text: Conversion tracking discrepancies (item 11929361375): several calls from Oct 11 and Oct 21 were not logged in GHL, and one contact had an incorrect source. The specialist corrected these manually. The lead's follow-up confirms the goal is full automation — worth confirming with the specialist that the automated tagging fix is fully live and retroactive records are resolved before marking done.

Web Lead Tracking item (13561643990) is in 'Start' status with only a lead instruction post — no specialist work logged in the window. Flag for review: has the audit begun? May need a specialist post or status update.

Fibid SEO rebuild (13383782873): the redesign preview link was shared internally (fibid.digitalcordex.io) but was due 11/13 and was delivered late (shared 11/17). Item is under Start status with no specialist work detail beyond sharing the link. Flagged as a Fibid item — confirm whether this falls within the Quality HVAC contract scope (lead note says 'HVAC support' is limited post-contract).

GBP Posting item (13565843665): no specialist post confirming that the first post was actually published this week — only the lead instruction exists. If posts weren't live by 11/18, this should not appear in 'done'. Kept in 'in_progress' pending confirmation.

Burr Ridge GBP (13383782872): lead note states 'this is the only HVAC support continuing after the contract ends' — suggests contract wind-down in progress. Internal awareness flag; do not surface to client.
